integrity: All-parameter proof supplied; finite small-case enumeration and supplementary tests separately identified. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
limitations: Exact coordinate-input controllability only for unit-weight line graphs of balanced complete r-partite graphs (r>=3, part size k>=2); no claims on energy, robustness, unequal part sizes or independently established publication priority.
title: An odd-unicycle criterion and a four-placement exception for multipartite line-graph control
